senses.gloss: m., pl. כְּלִיסִים, כְּלִיסִין (כלס, enlarg. of כל; cmp. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v. כרשׂ) bags.
units: Tosef. Kil. V, 26 אהולין והכ׳ הגרגים וכ׳ ed. Zuck. tents and bags, filters &c., v. אכסלי.—Trnsf. pods, a dehiscent fruit, similar to carob.
Ter. XI, 4 כ׳ וחרובים k’lisin and carobs; Ukts. I, 6 כְּלוּ׳ (Maim.: a species of figs, v. כְּלוּפְסִין).—
Ḥull. 67ᵇ (a species of peas, Rashi); Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 10, ch. XII, a. e. יתושין שבכ׳ the bugs found in &c.; Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᵇ bot.
